data.current_description:
Real guilt-by-association: top-K labelled behavioural neighbours.

Served by the on-request VM's faiss index over joint v5 embeddings. Each
neighbour carries its OWN chain (the index is joint — a neighbour may be on
the other chain) and any known label ("OFAC-SDN", entity name/category).

Two modes over the same index (see FaissSimilarStore.similar): raw
(default) = the frozen S3.a evidence surface; labelled = the product
surface the Maltego T2 transform consumes (61.6.b) and the 61.3.b anchor
criterion measures.

503 when the index is not wired (laptop / Lambda — idle=$0, S0 topology).
404 when the address is not a node in the graph (no embedding).
data.summary_suggestion: Find labeled similar addresses for risk investigation
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves top-K behaviorally similar addresses with compliance labels for guilt-by-association risk analysis. Requires chain and address parameters. Each result includes the neighbor's chain (may differ from query chain), known compliance labels (OFAC-SDN, entity name/category), and behavioral similarity score. Supports two response modes: raw (default) returns raw evidence data; labelled returns enriched compliance product data. Returns HTTP 404 if address has no embedding; HTTP 503 if the similarity index is unavailable. Cross-chain results enable comprehensive entity relationship mapping for compliance investigations.
